Single common IP vehicle control is used for both routes; oxaliplatin reference is route-matched. Histology subset n not stated, table n6 not borrowed. Author describes mild kidney epithelial swelling for BrPt3-IP, fewer alterations resembling control for BrPt3-gavage. Both recorded altered, without converting fewer alterations to no_change. BrPt3 liver has no explicit organ-specific interpretation, Outcome blank. OXP liver: enlarged/swollen hepatocytes and lymphocytic infiltration, route not distinguished in prose; OXP kidneys: irregular tubules, swollen epithelium, reduced cytoplasm and fewer nuclei, more pronounced after gavage.
